name: Sunflower Shape Cleaning Mop | 360° Rotating Extendable Microfiber | For Walls, Floors, Bathroom, Windows & Car Cleaning
description:
Make household cleaning faster and more efficient with the 360° Rotating Multi-Functional Cleaning Mop. Designed with a flexible rotating mop head and an extendable stainless steel handle, this versatile cleaning tool easily reaches corners, ceilings, under furniture, and other hard-to-clean areas. The ultra-absorbent microfiber mop head effectively removes dust, dirt, hair, and spills without scratching surfaces. Suitable for both wet and dry cleaning, it is perfect for floors, walls, windows, bathrooms, kitchens, ceilings, and even car washing. Its lightweight, durable, and reusable design makes everyday cleaning effortless.

Key Features
360° rotating mop head for flexible cleaning
Extendable stainless steel handle for extra reach
High-quality microfiber mop head
Suitable for both wet and dry cleaning
Easily cleans corners and hard-to-reach areas
Lightweight and easy to handle
Durable rust-resistant stainless steel construction
Washable and reusable microfiber pad
Ideal for floors, walls, windows, bathrooms, and cars
Saves time and effort during everyday cleaning

Product Specifications
Product Type: Multi-Functional Cleaning Mop
Mop Head: 360° Rotating Microfiber Head
Handle Material: Stainless Steel
Handle Type: Extendable Adjustable Handle
Cleaning Type: Wet & Dry Use

How to Use
Attach the microfiber mop head securely
Extend the handle to your preferred length
Use dry for dusting or dampen the mop for wet cleaning
Rotate the mop head to clean corners and tight spaces
Wash the microfiber pad after use and allow it to dry

Material / Composition
Stainless Steel Handle
High-Quality Microfiber Mop Head
Durable ABS Plastic Components

Safety Information
Wash the microfiber pad before first use
Do not use harsh chemicals on delicate surfaces
Allow the mop head to dry completely after washing
Store in a clean, dry place
Keep out of reach of children when not in use
